gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-slabo-13px: Bruno Ace SC strings its letters out like beads on a thread, every stroke the same in weight and every opening wide. Slabo 13px follows with a dignified, bookish voice, and its generous counters keep a full page of paragraphs easy on the eye.
gen-gf-cabin-sketch-fs-karma: Bold, chunky Cabin Sketch draws every stroke like a stout pipe cleaner, with no thinning anywhere along the line. And Karma brings the trustworthy counterweight, its hairline-to-stem swell so gentle that nothing snags the eye.
gen-gf-cabin-sketch-fs-paquito: Chunky, rod-like lettering with a hand-sketched wobble. Paquito comes in confident and approachable, with capitals sitting close to the lowercase, which suits the stretches of reading it was made for.
gen-gf-caesar-dressing-fs-paquito: Expressive and showy, Caesar Dressing lets its lowercase climb high against the capitals. Paquito does the quieter job of staying confident and approachable, built for short stretches of reading rather than display flourish.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-archivo: Calligraffitti looks traced with a marker, its counters spilling open and its midzone towering over everything. Archivo follows with an editorial, approachable build and a commanding x-height, though it was not meant for long paragraphs.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-fs-epilogue: Epilogue reads as approachable and contemporary, its curvy, wire-thin letters feeling pleasantly unclamped on the line. And Calligraffitti sits above in loose marker strokes, so the friendly handwriting and the slim sans make a lively mismatch for brief text.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-fs-erode: Erode reads editorial and dignified, with shallow ascenders and a broad open g and a. Calligraffitti above it feels like a single thick thread traced by hand, a loose contrast better kept for brief copy.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-fs-fira-sans: Loose marker loops with a towering midzone. But Fira Sans answers with wide-open s curves and a larger-than-usual x-height, and it was made for short stretches of reading.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-general-sans: Friendly marker scrawl with counters spilling into the space around it. General Sans runs on steady pen pressure with smooth bends, though it was not meant for a long passage of paragraphs.
gen-gf-calligraffitti-switzer: Friendly and graceful, Calligraffitti is at its best when its marker-traced strokes get room to spill and loom. Switzer does the opposite job, keeping its wire-like Swiss letters crisp with c tips that never creep together, ideal for short stretches of reading.
